title: Your True Story Might Not Be What You Think
hook: Your brain constantly invents false memories without you kno
script: Your brain constantly invents false memories without you knowing. Studies show our memory isn't a perfect recording device. Every time you recall an event, your brain reconstructs it, often filling in gaps with details that never happened. This isn't lying; it's just how our minds work. It means eyewitness testimonies can be incredibly unreliable, even from honest people. Imagine recalling a conversation, certain you remember every word, but your brain has actually edited the script. This phenomenon even explains why siblings remember childhood events so differently. It's not that one is wrong; both versions are just the brain's unique interpretation of reality. So, that "true story" you're holding onto? Your brain constantly invents false memories without you knowing.
comment: What's a memory you have that you're now wondering if it's entirely 'true'?
description:
Discover the surprising truth about how your brain stores memories. It turns out our personal "true stories" might be more like creative reconstructions than perfect recordings.
